plugins.name: worker-k
plugins.description: AI workforce skills for office automation — Excel, Word, PDF, research, bank reconciliation, and more. Built for accounting and professional service firms.

skills.name: bank-reconciliation
skills.description: Generate monthly bank reconciliation statements comparing bank statement balance to cash book balance. Use when the user asks for bank reconciliation, bank recon, cash book reconciliation, or needs to reconcile bank and book balances.
headings: Step 1: Read and Parse Input Files

skills.name: claim-form-extraction
skills.description: Extract and process data from claim forms (expense claims, insurance claims, medical claims, staff reimbursements, petty cash claims). Reads PDF/Excel/image claim forms, extracts claimant details, line items, amounts, and outputs structured Excel summaries. Use when the user mentions claim forms, expense claims, reimbursement claims, claim extraction, or needs to process/digitize claim documents.

skills.name: excel-processing
skills.description: Create, read, edit, and analyze Excel spreadsheets (.xlsx/.xls/.csv). Generate pivot tables, charts, financial schedules, reconciliations, and formatted reports. Use when working with Excel files, spreadsheets, tabular data, .xlsx files, CSV data, financial schedules, or data analysis tasks.

skills.name: management-rep-letter
skills.description: Update management representation letter templates with firm and client details. Use when the user needs to prepare, update, or generate management representation letters for audit engagements.

skills.name: pdf-processing
skills.description: Extract text and tables from PDF files, fill forms, merge/split PDFs, convert PDFs, add watermarks, and generate PDF reports. Use when working with PDF files, when the user mentions PDFs, forms, document extraction, PDF merging, splitting, watermarking, or PDF report generation.

skills.name: research
skills.description: Conduct thorough research and analysis on accounting, tax, audit, advisory, regulatory, and business topics. Use when the user asks to research a topic, analyze regulations, summarize standards, investigate a company, perform due diligence, or compile reference material on any professional subject.

skills.name: web-browse
skills.description: Browse websites, scrape web content, automate web interactions, and capture screenshots using Playwright. Use when the user asks to browse a website, scrape data, take screenshots, automate web tasks, check a URL, download web content, interact with web pages, or perform web-based research requiring page interaction.

skills.name: word-processing
skills.description: Create, read, edit, and format Word documents (.docx). Generate letters, reports, memos, proposals, engagement letters, and professional documents with tables, headers, footers, and styles. Use when working with Word files, .docx documents, letters, reports, memos, proposals, or document formatting.
